```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# Install packages if needed
# install.packages(c("readxl", "dplyr", "janitor"), dependencies = TRUE)

# Load libraries
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(janitor)
```

# Load Excel file

```{r}
data <- read_excel("raw/ESS latest term 3 2025.xlsx")
```

```{r, include = FALSE}
# View first rows
head(data)

# See columns
names(data)

# Clean headers
data <- data %>%
  clean_names()

# See new names
names(data)
```

```{r, include = TRUE}
data %>% 
  count(camp_sub_county)
```
